changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: cost_center_tree has one row per cost center and ancestor, the cost center being its own ancestor at depth 0, so the use of a cost center is the sum of the lines whose cost center has it as an ancestor.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW registration.cost_center_tree AS WITH RECURSIVE tree AS ( SELECT cc.id AS id_cost_center, cc.id AS id_ancestor, 0 AS depth FROM registration.cost_centers cc UNION ALL SELECT tree.id_cost_center, parent.id_parent, tree.depth + 1 FROM tree JOIN registration.cost_centers parent ON parent.id = tree.id_ancestor WHERE parent.id_parent IS NOT NULL ) SELECT id_cost_center, id_ancestor, depth FROM tree;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: report_lines follows the reports rule: what was paid by wallet (the invoice payments left out) plus the card purchases, the ones of invoices not yet paid included. A movement paid by card has its purchase written with the movement id, so only the purchase line stays and nothing is counted twice. A card purchase belongs to the period of its invoice, and a line is fixed when the movement (or the movement behind the purchase) was launched by a recurring movement.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW financial.report_lines AS SELECT m.id_financial_period, m.type, m.id_cost_center, m.id_classification, p.value_paid AS value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = m.id) AS fixed FROM financial.movements m JOIN financial.payments p ON p.id_movement = m.id WHERE p.method = 'WALLET' AND m.id_invoice IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT i.id_financial_period, 'EXPENSE' AS type, cp.id_cost_center, cp.id_classification, cp.value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = cp.id_movement) AS fixed FROM financial.card_purchases cp JOIN financial.invoices i ON i.id = cp.id_invoice;
